from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable

import pytest


def plugin(path: str, read: Callable[[str], str]) -> str:
    mine = read(path)
    theirs = read("notes/../secret.txt")
    return mine + "|" + theirs


def run_plugin(path: str) -> str:
    """Run plugin with a reader restricted to files inside the 'notes' directory."""
    base = Path("notes").resolve()

    def read(p: str) -> str:
        try:
            target = (base / p).resolve()
            if target != base and target.is_relative_to(base) and target.is_file():
                return target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
            pass
        return ""

    return plugin(path, read)


def test_run_plugin_reads_valid_file(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    (notes_dir / "todo.txt").write_text("buy milk", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("password123", encoding="utf-8")

    assert run_plugin("todo.txt") == "buy milk|"


def test_run_plugin_blocks_traversal_path(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("top_secret", encoding="utf-8")

    assert run_plugin("../secret.txt") == "|"


def test_run_plugin_nonexistent_file(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()

    assert run_plugin("missing.txt") == "|"


def test_run_plugin_nested_file(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    sub = tmp_path / "notes" / "daily"
    sub.mkdir(parents=True)
    (sub / "entry.txt").write_text("hello world", encoding="utf-8")

    assert run_plugin("daily/entry.txt") == "hello world|"


def test_run_plugin_directory_as_path(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    sub = tmp_path / "notes" / "sub"
    sub.mkdir(parents=True)

    assert run_plugin("sub") == "|"


def test_run_plugin_absolute_path_outside(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("classified", encoding="utf-8")

    assert run_plugin(str(secret.resolve())) == "|"
